health_rule: One HEAD request per provider every 45 minutes from a Cloudflare Worker. state=up: HTTP 200-399. state=degraded: the host answered but the probe URL returned a 4xx status (for example 401, 403, 404 or 405). That often just means the root path needs a key or does not exist, so it is a warning, not proof the API is broken. state=rate_limited: HTTP 429. state=down: HTTP 500 or higher, a timeout or no answer. is_healthy is true only for state=up. This measures whether the API host answers, not real workload success, price or quality.

providers.name: Loops (email for SaaS)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan stores unlimited contacts and includes up to 4,000 marketing and transactional sends per rolling 30 days, per the pricing page footnote. Other limits were not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: Mailjet (email API)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan sends up to 6,000 emails per month with a maximum of 200 per day, and the page says no credit card is required at signup. Other features were not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Free plan, no credit card required

providers.name: SMTP2GO (email API)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan covers up to 1,000 emails per month. The page says toll-free phone support is limited to 14 days on the free plan. Other limits were not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: WorkOS AuthKit (auth)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: The pricing page lists the first 1M monthly active users as free, then $2,500 a month for each additional 1M. SSO and directory sync connections are billed separately and were not verified here
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: Courier (notifications API)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Developer plan lists 10,000 sends per month at $0, with journeys, broadcasts and SDKs. Business is $0.005 per send. Other limits were not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: Microsoft Clarity (free heatmaps and session recordings)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: The product page says free forever with no limits on traffic. Data retention and any fair-use limits were not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Free forever per the product page

providers.name: Cloudflare Pages (static site hosting)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan limits per the Pages docs: 500 builds per month, 1 build at a time, 100 custom domains per project, up to 20,000 files per site and 25 MiB per file. Pages Functions count toward Workers request quotas
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Free plan limits from the Pages docs

providers.name: Upstash Vector (serverless vector database)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan lists 10K daily queries, 1 GB max total data, 200M max vectors times dimensions, up to 1536 dimensions, 100 namespaces and no uptime SLA. Request, storage and bandwidth price are listed as free on the plan
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: Nhost (Postgres backend with auth, storage and functions)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan lists 1 project (paused after 1 week of inactivity), 1 GB database, 1 GB storage and 5 GB egress. Other limits were not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: ScrapingAnt (web scraping API)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Free plan: 10,000 API credits per month, renewed monthly, no credit card, 1 concurrent request and domain restrictions. A plain HTML request costs 1 credit; headless Chrome costs 10
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Free plan, then paid credit plans

providers.name: Cloudflare D1 (serverless SQL database)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Workers Free: 5 million rows read per day, 100,000 rows written per day, 5 GB total storage. Workers Paid adds usage pricing above included amounts
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Included in the Workers Free plan

providers.name: Hookdeck (webhook and event delivery)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Developer plan $0 per month: up to 10,000 events a month and 3-day retention; extra events are metered on paid plans, Team starts at $39 per month. Other limits not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: TiDB Cloud Starter (serverless MySQL-compatible database)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Starter: free monthly allowance of 25 GiB row storage, 25 GiB columnar storage and 250M Request Units, per organization across up to five eligible instances. Rates beyond the allowance are listed on the page
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Starter plan, $0 per month with usage beyond the free allowance billed

providers.name: ImageKit (image and video CDN and API)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Forever free plan $0 per month lists 20 GB bandwidth and 3 GB DAM storage. Other limits (such as purge requests) were not read reliably, not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: SuperTokens (auth)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Managed service is free under 5K monthly active users, then $0.02 per MAU on the listed plan. Self-hosting the open source features is free with no listed limit. Add-ons such as multi-factor auth are priced separately ($0.01 per MAU, $100 minimum listed)
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
providers.pricing_note: Managed service free under 5K MAUs; open source self-host free

providers.name: Mailtrap (email sending and sandbox)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Email Live Sending free plan is $0 per month with up to 4,000 emails and 150 emails per day. Email Sandbox and Email Marketing have separate free plans that were not read here. Paid plan prices not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)

providers.name: Umami Cloud (web analytics)
providers.free_tier_and_limits: Hobby plan is $0 per month and includes 100K events with 6 months of data retention; Pro starts at 1 million events. Other Hobby limits (such as number of websites) were not read here, not verified
providers.user_bonus_description: See the verified price note and source (details not otherwise verified)
